svg.title: Base Case: $675,000 Billings to $189,000 Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-gross-to-owner-profit; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case: $675,000 Billings to $189,000 Owner Profit; subtitle: Separate upstream pass-through economics from retained operating performance.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Annual USD; canonical retained_share is 0.65. The $168,000 operating-cost and $81,750 variable-cost allocations are illustrative components of the required $249,750 post-upstream cost total. Bars 1, 3, and 6 are absolute totals; bars 2, 4, and 5 are signed movements. Never add the retained subtotal twice.; caption: $675,000 − $236,250 = $438,750 retained contribution; $438,750 − $168,000 − $81,750 = $189,000 owner profit. Profit is 28.0% of gross billings and 43.08% of retained contribution. The scorecard's ASC 606 net presentation assumes an agent arrangement; assess principal-versus-agent status separately for each promised service.; stages: label: Gross customer billings; value: $675,000 annual delivered compute and telecom billings; numeric value: 675000.0; detail: Opening total equals $56,250 monthly on an annualized basis. These are operator customer billings, not customers' underlying commerce, token resale proceeds, or enterprise revenue.; label: Upstream capacity cost; value: Subtract $236,250 for upstream capacity and termination; numeric value: -236250.0; detail: Thirty-five percent of gross billings goes to supplier capacity and carrier termination, including the modeled effect of commits. Do not deduct these charges again below.; label: Retained contribution; value: $438,750 remains after the upstream supplier deduction; numeric value: 438750.0; detail: Subtotal equals 65% of gross billings and $36,562.50 monthly. Use this denominator for the retained-margin view; it is not the owner's take-home profit.; label: Recurring operating costs; value: Subtract $168,000 for recurring pod and platform operations; numeric value: -168000.0; detail: Illustrative expense envelope equals $14,000 monthly, the canonical range ceiling. Allocate it to contractor support, observability, administration, and recurring tooling.; label: Variable operating costs; value: Subtract $81,750 for variable fulfillment and collection costs; numeric value: -81750.0; detail: Illustrative annual allocation covers processing fees, chargeback losses, service credits, and non-upstream variable support. Keep these outside the recurring monthly envelope and avoid duplicating supplier capacity charges.; label: Annual owner profit; value: $189,000 remains after all modeled operating deductions; numeric value: 189000.0; detail: Closing total equals $15,750 monthly on an annualized basis. Preserve the canonical owner-profit convention; personal taxes and an additional imputed owner salary are not separately modeled.

text.title: Base Case: $675,000 Billings to $189,000 Owner Profit
text.tspan: Base Case: $675,000 Billings to $189,000 Owner Profit

rect.title: label: Gross customer billings; value: $675,000 annual delivered compute and telecom billings; numeric value: 675000.0; detail: Opening total equals $56,250 monthly on an annualized basis. These are operator customer billings, not customers' underlying commerce, token resale proceeds, or enterprise revenue.

label: Upstream capacity cost; value: Subtract $236,250 for upstream capacity and termination; numeric value: -236250.0; detail: Thirty-five percent of gross billings goes to supplier capacity and carrier termination, including the modeled effect of commits. Do not deduct these charges again below.

label: Retained contribution; value: $438,750 remains after the upstream supplier deduction; numeric value: 438750.0; detail: Subtotal equals 65% of gross billings and $36,562.50 monthly. Use this denominator for the retained-margin view; it is not the owner's take-home profit.

label: Recurring operating costs; value: Subtract $168,000 for recurring pod and platform operations; numeric value: -168000.0; detail: Illustrative expense envelope equals $14,000 monthly, the canonical range ceiling. Allocate it to contractor support, observability, administration, and recurring tooling.

label: Variable operating costs; value: Subtract $81,750 for variable fulfillment and collection costs; numeric value: -81750.0; detail: Illustrative annual allocation covers processing fees, chargeback losses, service credits, and non-upstream variable support. Keep these outside the recurring monthly envelope and avoid duplicating supplier capacity charges.

label: Annual owner profit; value: $189,000 remains after all modeled operating deductions; numeric value: 189000.0; detail: Closing total equals $15,750 monthly on an annualized basis. Preserve the canonical owner-profit convention; personal taxes and an additional imputed owner salary are not separately modeled.

text.title: Assumptions: Annual USD; canonical retained_share is 0.65. The $168,000 operating-cost and $81,750 variable-cost allocations are illustrative components of the required $249,750 post-upstream cost total. Bars 1, 3, and 6 are absolute totals; bars 2, 4, and 5 are signed movements. Never add the retained subtotal twice.
